reported_pattern: Adults tend to aggregate in winter and early spring in the sampled northern Taiwan rocky shore population.
geographic_scope: 台灣北部基隆附近岩岸
limitations: Single northern Taiwan rocky shore and historical sample; not East Taiwan catch rate or a guaranteed annual fishing window. Candidate c001 is a common-name alias gate; require individual morphological identification before any species-level inference.

reported_pattern: Species database describes the species as diurnal and adults as associated with exposed rocky surf zones.
limitations: No East Taiwan hourly activity measurements, seasonal stratification or quantified activity rate. Does not establish best fishing time. Candidate c001 remains subject to individual identification.

reported_pattern: Reported feeding approximately 09:00–17:00 with a more pronounced peak around 13:00–15:00 in a controlled algae-feeding study.
limitations: Captive/controlled algae feeding is not wild activity, bite rate or response to fishing bait. Do not recommend 09:00–17:00 as an East Taiwan fishing window.

reported_pattern: Gillnet catch and habitat modelling showed higher concentration from December to April within 3 nautical miles of western Taiwan coast.
sample_size: fishery dataset; exact sample count not stated here
method: gillnet catch locations plus remote-sensing covariates and seasonal MaxEnt model
limitations: Western Taiwan gillnet spatial catch model is not East Taiwan shore-angling diel activity or catch probability; gear, grounds and oceanography differ.

activity_measure: daily telemetry signal count; nighttime signal absence reported
reported_pattern: Daily signal total declined around 16–17°C and no signals were recorded at night during the study; fish remained near the algal bed.
study_period: 2004-11 onward; tracked for more than four months
sample_size: study reports telemetry tracking; exact K. bigibbus count not separately specified in this register
limitations: Telemetry detections are an activity proxy, not feeding, bite or catch rate. Species-specific to K. bigibbus; do not transfer to K. cinerascens or all white-hair aliases.

reported_pattern: Species database describes the species as diurnal and associated with mid-upper water over exposed rocky reefs and surf zones.
geographic_scope: Taiwan species database summary; broad rocky-shore distribution
limitations: Broad species profile is not an East Taiwan hourly field study; depth and habitat descriptions are not fishing-depth or bite-time recommendations.

reported_pattern: Species database describes the species as diurnal and associated with mid-upper water over exposed reefs, algal beds and lagoons.
geographic_scope: Taiwan species database summary; broad rocky-shore distribution
limitations: Broad species profile is not an East Taiwan hourly field study; no quantified activity rate or fishing catch response. Applies only to confirmed K. cinerascens.
